minimum_data_check: Primary purchase value, final URL country parameter, country currency, Merchant/Pinterest proof, checkout readback, and campaign settings are current
kill_or_narrow_trigger: Any prerequisite is stale, ambiguous, or failed
required_action: Do not activate until gates pass
blocked_action: No live spend or enablement by inference
owner_approval_needed: Yes for any activation or platform write

minimum_data_check: Spend, search terms, CPC, CTR, primary purchases, conversion value, final URL country
kill_or_narrow_trigger: About $5 spend with weak terms, broad intent, irrelevant products, or no qualified engagement
hold_condition: Spend below $5 with clean terms and no tracking/catalog issues
required_action: Pause or narrow the smallest losing unit after approval; add negatives only with approved write scope
blocked_action: Do not scale from CTR, cheap CPC, add_to_cart, or checkout starts
owner_approval_needed: Yes for pause, bid, negative, budget, or status changes

minimum_data_check: Spend, primary purchase count, CPA, ROAS, search terms, landing page and currency
kill_or_narrow_trigger: $9.49-$10.77 spend with 0 purchases; use $9.49-$9.73 for weaker international evidence
hold_condition: One clean purchase can justify hold while CPA and terms are reviewed
required_action: Force pause, narrow, or owner decision at one target-CPA window
blocked_action: Do not expand keywords, countries, or budgets from micro-conversions

minimum_data_check: Spend, purchases, ROAS, CPA, conversion action, value, currency, terms
hold_condition: Hold only with clean engagement and explicit owner decision
scale_trigger: 3+ clean purchases, CPA <= target, ROAS >= 650%, clean terms and values
required_action: Hard pause losing unit or document owner-approved hold; scale winners gradually
blocked_action: Do not scale wider than 10%-20% borderline or 20%-30% clean winners every 3-7 days

minimum_data_check: Post-bid-change spend, purchases, ROAS, product groups, search terms, Merchant/source health
kill_or_narrow_trigger: One target-CPA window with 0 purchases triggers owner decision; $16-$20 with 0 purchases recommends rollback decision
hold_condition: Hold only if queries/products are clean and owner accepts the test window
scale_trigger: 3+ paid-cohort purchases, ROAS >= 650%, clean queries, no Merchant/source regression
required_action: Recommend decision; do not edit campaign from this lane
blocked_action: No Standard Shopping status, budget, bid, product group, product scope, feed label, or conversion-goal changes

minimum_data_check: Event Quality, Tag/CAPI freshness, catalog scope, product proof, outbound clicks, saves, add_to_cart, checkout, purchases
kill_or_narrow_trigger: No spend if Event Quality risk is unaccepted, 342/4 scope is not preserved, or item proof is stale; $9.49-$10.77 with 0 purchases pauses
hold_condition: Hold only with owner-accepted measurement risk and strong product engagement
scale_trigger: 3+ purchases, clean purchase value, CPA <= target, ROAS >= 650%
required_action: Keep paused or pause/rebuild targeting and creative based on smallest losing unit
blocked_action: Do not scale from saves, impressions, outbound clicks, or checkout starts alone
